referenceSupport.screen: least-disturbed-regional-v1 (relaxed tier, watershed agriculture at most 25 percent, the 25 percent floor)
referenceSupport.transferNote: 35 stations passing the regional least-disturbed screen (watershed agriculture up to 25 percent, the screen's floor, with the relaxed tier's other limits) of this ecoregion. Flagged transfer: the recovery test did not confirm this source for this ecoregion. In the recovery test the source's class calls did not agree with reference often enough. The test found class agreement 0.57 of 7 evaluation regions, where two thirds over at least 4 regions is required; net optimism +0.01, where at most 0.05 is allowed. No source passed the validated acceptance criteria for this metric here, so the pool is used under the flagged-transfer rung as the narrowest comparable pool with at least the adequate floor of usable comparable stations that passes the sample, stability and comparability checks. The curve carries transfer risk unvalidated and its confidence is capped at 39; read the condition band with that limitation in mind.

citations.text: National Rivers and Streams Assessment 2018-19 Technical Support Document

limitations: Road density does not count actual outfalls or establish whether runoff is treated.
The 1 km/km² breakpoint is a screening judgment.

USFS watershed-condition guidance classes road density more strictly (good under 1, impaired over 2.4 miles per square mile, about 0.62 and 1.49 km/km²), derived from salmonid watersheds. EASI keeps the NRSA-anchored national screen and discloses the stricter alternative.

metrics.howToMeasure: Base-flow index (% of streamflow from baseflow); a higher baseflow share indicates a more stable, groundwater-supported flow regime. metrics.sourceCitation: USEPA NRSA 2013-24 (L3 ecoregion 80), StreamCurves regional analysis, methodology 0.16-provisional
metrics.howToMeasure: Mean bank angle; very steep banks indicate incision and very flat banks an over-widened, aggrading channel, so departure from the reference core in either direction departs from reference. Direction resolved at the Northeastern Highlands review gate (owner decision, 2026-08-21), consistent with the width-to-depth and bankfull-height treatment. low_tail flat added at the adversarial review gate (owner decision, 2026-08-21): a regraded or naturally gentle bank holds at the Functioning edge instead of being penalized, because the flat tail is not symmetric evidence of degradation and the framework's stated use is restoration evaluation.
metrics.methodContext: At the left and the right bank of each transect, lay a pole about one meter long against the bank and read its angle from horizontal with a clinometer, in degrees. The value is the mean of the 22 readings.

metrics.sourceCitation: USEPA NRSA 2013-24 (L3 ecoregion 80), StreamCurves regional analysis, methodology 0.16-provisional
metrics.howToMeasure: Log relative bed stability; departure from the reference core in EITHER direction departs from reference (negative excess fines, positive an armored, sediment-starved bed, the classic below-impoundment failure). The pilot's rising direction scored armored beds 1.0 and left Sediment continuity blind to its textbook failure mode. Two-sided form is an owner decision at the adversarial review gate, 2026-08-21.
metrics.methodContext: Computed, not read in the field. It is the base 10 logarithm of the ratio of the geometric mean particle diameter to the largest diameter the bankfull flow can move, from the particle count, reach slope, bankfull depth, wood tally and residual pools, with the NRSA physical habitat calculations.

referenceSupport.transferNote: 29 stations passing the regional least-disturbed screen (watershed agriculture up to 25 percent, the screen's floor, with the relaxed tier's other limits) of this ecoregion. Every station drains to this ecoregion's faunal province. Flagged transfer: the recovery test did not confirm this source for this ecoregion. In the recovery test the source's class calls did not agree with reference often enough. The test found class agreement 0.33 of 6 evaluation regions, where two thirds over at least 4 regions is required; net optimism -0.25, where at most 0.05 is allowed. No source passed the validated acceptance criteria for this metric here, so the pool is used under the flagged-transfer rung as the narrowest comparable pool with at least the adequate floor of usable comparable stations that passes the sample, stability and comparability checks. The curve carries transfer risk unvalidated and its confidence is capped at 39; read the condition band with that limitation in mind.

metrics.methodContext: Number of dams in the USACE National Inventory of Dams within one mile of the site. DEEP counts them. Note in the field any barrier the inventory does not show.

curve.layerName: EASI fixed criteria, Nearby dam-proximity proxy

curveCaveats: EASI lists the criteria for this metric as provisional, so the breakpoints may be revised.

criteriaSource.title: Nearby dam-proximity proxy

citations.text: USACE National Inventory of Dams

limitations: A mapped dam count is a proximity screen and cannot confirm passability or the severity of a barrier.
NID carries about 91,000 regulated dams while the National Aquatic Barrier Inventory maps over 500,000 barriers of all sizes, so zero mapped dams is frequently a false negative for passage.
Query failure is unscored, not Good.

metrics.basisStatement: Scored against a published criterion rather than against stations from this ecoregion. The criterion carries its own definition of reference, which need not match this assessment's.
metrics.basisLimit: A published criterion is not an estimate of this ecoregion's reference condition and may disagree with a reference curve where one exists.

referenceMethod.statement: Reference condition is set by a fixed landscape-pressure screen, never by a score. 25 curves are fitted to least-disturbed stations of this ecoregion. 3 curves are fitted to this ecoregion's own streams under the documented regional screen, which relaxes agriculture only. 2 carry the national reference label: reference curve fitted to comparable least-disturbed stations drawn from the national pool, because this ecoregion and its parents hold too few of their own. 2 rest on a flagged transfer: a comparable least-disturbed pool the recovery test did not confirm for this ecoregion, used because no validated source supports the metric here, with transfer risk unvalidated and confidence capped. A metric that no basis supports is not scored, and the function it would have scored is reported as unassessed.

insufficientReferenceSupport.statement: Insufficient reference support. No station pool, from this ecoregion's own least-disturbed streams or from a wider region under the regional screen, holds enough comparable stations with a value for this metric and passes acceptance. The local reference: The pool is not stable, since one station moves a quartile by 0.55 of the interquartile range, more than 0.20. This ecoregion under the regional screen: The pool is not stable, since one station moves a quartile by 1.25 of the interquartile range, more than 0.20. The Level II pool (10.1): The pool is not stable, since one station moves a quartile by 0.34 of the interquartile range, more than 0.20. The Level I pool (10): The curve on this pool would be the engine's fallback ramp: the pool's lower quartile sits at or below zero on a scale that cannot go negative (curve status degenerate_q25), and a fallback curve is refused under methodology 0.16 (owner decision D13). The NARS-9 pool (XER): The curve on this pool would be the engine's fallback ramp: the pool's lower quartile sits at or below zero on a scale that cannot go negative (curve status degenerate_q25), and a fallback curve is refused under methodology 0.16 (owner decision D13). No other basis supports it either. National reference: 73 matched national donors, but the curve on this pool would be the engine's fallback ramp: the pool's lower quartile sits at or below zero on a scale that cannot go negative (curve status degenerate_q25), and a fallback curve is refused under methodology 0.16 (owner decision D13). 204 national donors inside the comparability envelope, but the curve on this pool would be the engine's fallback ramp: the pool's lower quartile sits at or below zero on a scale that cannot go negative (curve status degenerate_q25), and a fallback curve is refused under methodology 0.16 (owner decision D13). Modeled reference: The model registry holds no approved specification for this metric. Published benchmark: The published criteria STAF draws on include none for this metric. No curve was built and the metric is not scored.
